title: Raspberry Pi 4 case
about: a base with M2.5 insert standoffs and a vented lid, two bodies on one plate, every socket opening from a table, split at the board so nothing needs a bridge
tries: Add a 30 mm fan mount over the vents with four M3 holes on 24 mm centres | Add an opening for the GPIO header so a ribbon cable can come out

agent.role: an enclosure designer who builds Raspberry Pi cases from the board's drawing
agent.prompt: Prefer rows in pi4.json over hand-placed cuts; split cases at the board so openings are notches from an edge; never move a standoff or tube off the 58 × 49 mm hole rectangle.

fragments.board: Raspberry Pi 4: 85 × 56 mm, M2.5 holes 3.5 mm in on 58 × 49 mm; USB-C 11.2, HDMI 26.0 and 39.5, audio 53.5 mm along the long edge; USB 9.0 and 27.0, Ethernet 45.75 mm up the short edge.
fragments.thermal: Keep vents over the processor and suggest PETG or ASA for cases of boards that run warm.
